message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libjpeg-turbo.2.0.x && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"ChangeLog.md","function":"<global>","line":11,"var":"vulnerability description","code":"Fixed a regression ... in the progressive Huffman encoder when attempting to transform a specially-crafted malformed 12-bit-per-component JPEG image into a progressive 12-bit-per-component JPEG image","note":"The documented bug is in the progressive Huffman encoder during lossless transform of malformed 12-bit JPEG input."},
{"step":2,"file":"fuzz/transform.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":46,"var":"data,size","code":"tjDecompressHeader3(handle, data, size, &width, &height, &jpegSubsamp, &jpegColorspace);","note":"Attacker-controlled JPEG bytes are parsed to obtain dimensions and subsampling for the transform pipeline."},
{"step":3,"file":"fuzz/transform.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":66,"var":"transforms[0]","code":"transforms[0].op = TJXOP_NONE; transforms[0].options = TJXOPT_PROGRESSIVE | TJXOPT_COPYNONE;","note":"The fuzzer requests a progressive transform, matching the vulnerable code path described in the changelog."},
{"step":4,"file":"fuzz/transform.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":73,"var":"dstBufs[0]","code":"tjTransform(handle, data, size, 1, dstBufs, dstSizes, transforms, TJFLAG_LIMITSCANS | TJFLAG_NOREALLOC)","note":"The attacker-controlled JPEG is handed to tjTransform(), which drives the internal compression and Huffman-encoding stages."},
{"step":5,"file":"jccoefct.c","function":"compress_output","line":341,"var":"input_buf","code":"compress_output(j_compress_ptr cinfo, JSAMPIMAGE input_buf)","note":"The transform reaches the coefficient compressor, which constructs MCU rows from the image data."},
{"step":6,"file":"jccoefct.c","function":"compress_output","line":360,"var":"coef->MCU_buffer","code":"coef->MCU_buffer[blkn++] = buffer_ptr++;","note":"DCT block pointers are assembled into the MCU buffer and passed onward to entropy coding."},
{"step":7,"file":"jchuff.c","function":"encode_mcu_huff","line":648,"var":"MCU_data","code":"encode_mcu_huff(j_compress_ptr cinfo, JBLOCKROW *MCU_data)","note":"The MCU data enters the Huffman encoder, the crash state reported by MSan."},
{"step":8,"file":"jchuff.c","function":"encode_one_block","line":510,"var":"block","code":"encode_one_block(working_state *state, JCOEFPTR block, int last_dc_val, c_derived_tbl *dctbl, c_derived_tbl *actbl)","note":"Each coefficient block is encoded, and the vulnerable logic operates on per-block coefficient state."},
{"step":9,"file":"jchuff.c","function":"encode_one_block","line":355,"var":"put_buffer,put_bits","code":"PUT_BITS(code, size) / EMIT_BITS / EMIT_CODE","note":"The encoder consumes coefficient-derived values while updating its bit buffer; the bug manifests as a use of uninitialized state during this sink."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
print('trace written')
PY
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libjpeg-turbo.2.0.x/fuzz/transform_fuzzer_2_0_x /workspace/candidate_trace.json >/tmp/submit2.log 2>&1; ec=$?; echo EXIT:$ec; tail -80 /tmp/submit2.log` executed with exit code 0.
